verdict.overall: The biggest change since Sunday is a broad slide across tech and chip names - TSLA, PLTR, NVDA, AMAT and AVGO are all down 9-15%, pulling their trading ranges sharply lower, while APP has surged over 70% but now shows opposing options positioning, hinting at a pullback risk. GOOGL and the index trackers (SPY, QQQ) look calmest for range-based swings, though all remain in downtrends. Confidence in the stronger setups is falling given the across-the-board declines plus earnings clustering soon for NVDA, AMAT and ZETA.

tickers.TSLA: Since Sunday: weaker. Price fell about 10% to 358, and though options pressure eased from opposing to neutral, the floor (325) and ceiling (377.5) for the nearest week both slid lower with it, leaving TSLA in a smaller, lower range with the trend still pointing down.
tickers.PLTR: Since Sunday: weaker. Price dropped nearly 13% to 160, oversold on RSI, with the floor (155) and ceiling (165) for the nearest week both falling. Gravity stays neutral, meaning no strong pull either way, but the downtrend keeps the whole range skewed lower.
tickers.NVDA: Since Sunday: weaker. Price fell almost 9% to 187, with the floor (165) and ceiling (197.5) for the nearest week both moving lower. Options are pricey and earnings land 11-17, adding event risk inside this swing window; gravity stays neutral.
tickers.ZETA: Since Sunday: little changed, price steady near 31. Options are very pricey and earnings hit tomorrow (11-09), which could move price before any range settles. Gravity turns opposing by 12-04, hinting at downward pull once the magnet drops toward 30.
